test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A 255-m long train is running at a speed of 72 km/h. It crosses a platform of length 745 m in:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train = 255 m

Speed of the train = 72 km/h

Length of the platform = 745 m

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Total distance to be covered = Length of the train + Length of the platform

Total distance = 255 m + 745 m

Total distance = 1000 m

Speed of the train in m/s = Speed in km/h × (1000 m / 1 km) × (1 h / 3600 s)

Speed = 72 × (5 / 18)

Speed = 20 m/s

Time = Total distance / Speed

Time = 1000 m / 20 m/s

⇒ Time = 50 seconds

**The train crosses the platform in 50 seconds.**
